purpose: Appium XCTest-based iOS UI automation agent and Node.js build/launch helpers
decisive_diff: All lib/*.js, Objective-C sources, scripts, and dependency/lifecycle declarations are byte-identical.
build/lib/utils.js executable text and decoded sourcesContent are identical; only source-map mappings differ.
project.pbxproj adds VALIDATE_WORKSPACE = NO for Debug and Release; package.json only changes version.

Bundled simulator runner/framework metadata changes from DTXcode 1230 / DTXcodeBuild 12C5020b / SDK iphonesimulator14.2.internal / XCTest 17501 to DTXcode 1020 / DTXcodeBuild 10G1d / SDK iphonesimulator12.2 / XCTest 14490.71; an older XCTest runner template is bundled.
Runner CodeDirectory identifier changes from com.facebook.WebDriverAgentRunner.xctrunner to com.apple.test.WebDriverAgentRunner-Runner. Both releases are ad-hoc signed.
Other archive changes are Finder metadata, Xcode user workspace files, and corresponding rebuilt XCTest frameworks/agent binaries.

execution_trace.runner: x86_64 main at 0x100002164 selects UIApplicationMain or __XCTRunnerRunTests; __XCTRunnerRunTests loads _XCTLoadTestConfiguration and calls _XCTestMain, or logs and exits if configuration is missing.
execution_trace.test_plugin: UITestingUITests::testRunner at 0xf90 allocates FBWebServer, sets its delegate and calls startServing at 0x1004.
execution_trace.server: FBWebServer startServing starts RoutingHTTPServer and the MJPEG screenshot broadcaster, then services the run loop. Routes deserialize JSON and dispatch WebDriver automation requests.
execution_trace.obfuscation: No hidden launcher or encrypted payload was found. JavaScript Base64 data URLs are source maps, decoded and compared across releases.

false_positives.apple_signing: Ad-hoc plus Apple-prefixed identifier is signing metadata, not evidence of forgery. Relocated and renamed to metadata/signed/trust-level::adhoc-apple-identifier at notable; authenticated Apple provenance still requires the existing chain-anchor rule.
false_positives.go_tls: Bare CipherSuites at library file offset 1175646 is among CocoaAsyncSocket SSL option strings, not a Go type. Require qualified crypto/tls.CipherSuites reference.
false_positives.family_consumer: Foxveil consumer references neutral signing fact and additionally requires existing family-specific key-wipe dispatch fingerprint.
false_positives.terminal: XCTest offset 890956 is a GUI screen string adjacent to main screen and screenshot labels. Require TERM=screen context.
false_positives.signal: FBSession -(void)kill terminates its tested application and clears session state; it is not an int kill(pid_t, int) POSIX definition. Require that function-definition ABI.
false_positives.compiler: Scripts/build.sh passes clang as a directory argument to find when collecting static-analyzer HTML. Require command position for compiler invocation.
false_positives.webclient: Scripts/fetch-prebuilt-wda.js calls appium-support net.downloadFile; require Net.WebClient context for the .NET-specific observation.
false_positives.testing: check-dependencies.js is a production prerequisite checker. Remove the unsupported test-harness attribution based solely on a check-* filename; no exact consumers require it.

verification.apple_signing_controls: 3/3 passed, including genuine Apple provenance control
verification.malware_control: macho-osa-tamper-gated retains four hostile behavior findings
